tiles: The pieces that felt most honest to me
challenge: I kept noticing the same thread running through Fauvism, Synthetism, Impressionism, and later psychedelic art — color used for feeling rather than for description. I wanted to follow that thread and see where my own taste landed within it.
approach: I read across all four movements, then drafted a lot of variations around a single idea — a face with its eyes closed, listening inward, surrounded by color doing the emotional work. I kept the ones that felt most honest about that quiet, internal brightness.
result: The pieces here are the ones I kept returning to — warm, radiant, a little euphoric. They're available as prints in case anyone else enjoys sitting with that kind of color.
